title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a f9v name reading needs a downstream referent link
summary: If fochor is a plant name, a complete f9v reading might contain an explicit later reference to the named plant, its part, or its preparation. Predeclare the candidate link's exact whole-form span and binding rule, plus an entry-address alternative in which no such name link is required. Check complete discourse ownership and do not infer a word translation from mere co-occurrence. Whether any eligible link exists is unknown.

design.unit: complete f9v entry and exact candidate antecedent-reference pair
design.prediction: a name reading yields a predeclared coherent downstream referent link that an address reading does not need
